cues.STORY_D06_MANAGEMENT_001: Hi. Here for that security reassessment I promised. You do open the door for guests with appointments, right?
cues.STORY_D06_MANAGEMENT_002: Booking a break-in is not an appointment. It's advance notice of a crime.
cues.STORY_D06_MANAGEMENT_003: You say that, but you kept my note. Were you waiting for me?
cues.STORY_D06_MANAGEMENT_004: I kept it as evidence. At the very back of the throne drawer.
cues.STORY_D06_MANAGEMENT_005: My lord, you did not need to disclose the hiding place.
cues.STORY_D06_MANAGEMENT_006: Today's score is irrelevant. Lose a single gold coin, and my skull will lose its shine.
cues.STORY_D06_MANAGEMENT_007: First time I've seen a skeleton worry about its complexion.
cues.STORY_D06_MANAGEMENT_008: My complexion is the balance in the vault.
cues.STORY_D06_MANAGEMENT_009: You stamped those supply crates, right? Another thief followed me here. Your publicity's working.
cues.STORY_D06_MANAGEMENT_010: I advertised, and got more thieves instead of customers.
cues.STORY_D06_MANAGEMENT_011: I'd abolish our marketing department, but we haven't even founded one.
cues.STORY_D06_PRECOMBAT_001: The explorers will open the main route while Nia and the thieves push toward the Treasury.
cues.STORY_D06_PRECOMBAT_002: Pudding, hold the line. Gob, chase down any thieves slipping away. Pynn, burn through the gaps from the rear.
cues.STORY_D06_PRECOMBAT_003: Gaps burn too? Then Gob hit them before they all burn up!
cues.STORY_D06_PRECOMBAT_004: Don't race my fireballs. Last time, only your fringe lost.
cues.STORY_D06_PRECOMBAT_005: Fine today. Already short. Nobody notice.
cues.STORY_D06_PRECOMBAT_006: Is Nia going to keep coming to fight us?
cues.STORY_D06_PRECOMBAT_007: For now, she's an enemy. But see even an enemy often enough, and you start calling them by name.
cues.STORY_D06_PRECOMBAT_008: Touching. Now call my name and toss me the vault key!
cues.STORY_D06_COMBAT_01_001: The explorers cleared the way. I'll head for the expensive stuff, as usual.
cues.STORY_D06_COMBAT_01_002: As usual? It's your second visit! Stop pretending you're a regular!
cues.STORY_D06_COMBAT_01_003: No loyalty discounts! Repeat intruders pay a surcharge!
cues.STORY_D06_COMBAT_01_004: Catch me and I'll settle up. Otherwise, I'll take what I reckon I'm owed.
cues.STORY_D06_COMBAT_02_001: Got you! No, nearly got you! No, getting you now!
cues.STORY_D06_COMBAT_02_002: Less running commentary. More actual running.
cues.STORY_D06_COMBAT_02_003: Your movements are better than before. You really are learning.
cues.STORY_D06_COMBAT_02_004: You keep coming to test us. Be ready to give us full marks next time.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_001: I'll grade your movements more than your doors. And what you actually managed to protect.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_002: At last, a thief recognizes my castle as an educational institution.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_003: We received a repair bill instead of tuition.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_004: Empty-handed this time. I'll have to raise your score quite a bit.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_005: Treasury balance confirmed. My complexion has returned.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_006: Your bones are the same color as before.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_007: Got a few coins. Your pursuit's faster, but the vault door is still very forthcoming.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_008: The balance has dropped. So has the color in my face.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_009: Your bones do look a little paler.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_010: Some complexions are visible only to accountants.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_011: Fix up your facilities. Next time, it won't be me. It'll be people who just smash their way in.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_012: Nia has a point. Tomorrow, we will discuss making one of our facilities sturdier.
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_001: For 90 gold and 30 mana, we can upgrade one facility by one level.
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_002: Why are those numbers so proudly enormous? At least pretend to be sorry.
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_003: 90 gold... 30 mana... My apologies. The price remains unchanged.
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_004: The Barracks offer stability, the Watch Post responds quickly to thieves, and the Recovery Nest helps in long battles.
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_005: No option to make the throne softer?
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_007: No. The defense line comes before your lower back, my lord.
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_008: Pudding's happy anywhere. Just not under a leaky ceiling. It keeps ruining the seasoning.
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_009: Barracks bigger! Now Gob stop punching wall in sleep!
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_010: The fact that you punch things in your sleep is the bigger problem.
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_011: We should be able to spot thieves' flanking routes sooner.
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_012: Nice angle on that watch post window. I'll find a blind spot next time.
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_013: So soft! Pudding comes in here and gets all bouncy again, like a dessert!
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_014: This looks more like a holiday resort than a medical facility.
cues.STORY_D07_PRECOMBAT_001: Choosing just one is harder than I thought. Can't we fix them all?
cues.STORY_D07_PRECOMBAT_002: Certainly. If your future self sends your present self the money.
cues.STORY_D07_PRECOMBAT_003: Gob like big rooms! Swing fist without hitting wall!
cues.STORY_D07_PRECOMBAT_004: That has more to do with your sense of direction than room size.
cues.STORY_D07_PRECOMBAT_005: A better Recovery Nest means Pudding gets bouncy again faster.
cues.STORY_D07_PRECOMBAT_006: There is no single right answer. Choose a facility that suits today's formation and your future plans.
cues.STORY_D07_PRECOMBAT_007: Right. We'll build the perfect castle later. Today, we build the castle we need.
cues.STORY_D07_PRECOMBAT_008: Your first truly lordly statement within budget. I'll make a note of it.
cues.STORY_D07_COMBAT_01_001: Explorers are entering along the main route. A thief will head for the Treasury later.
cues.STORY_D07_COMBAT_01_002: Hold around the upgraded facility! We paid for it, so make it earn its keep!
cues.STORY_D07_COMBAT_01_003: An admirable commitment to recovering our investment.
cues.STORY_D07_COMBAT_01_004: Do we have to take accounting lessons in battle too?
cues.STORY_D07_COMBAT_02_001: Upgraded room strong! Can Gob punch wall once?
cues.STORY_D07_COMBAT_02_002: Punch the enemy! Testing our facilities' durability is not on today's agenda!
cues.STORY_D07_COMBAT_02_003: Pudding will block the front. New room, help us from behind!
cues.STORY_D07_COMBAT_02_004: The defense line is stable. The chosen facility is doing its job.
cues.STORY_D07_RESULT_WIN_001: We fixed one wall, and the whole castle looks a little prouder.
cues.STORY_D07_RESULT_WIN_002: The wall isn't proud. It simply isn't collapsing. A major improvement.
cues.STORY_D07_RESULT_WIN_003: The investment was substantial, but projected repairs are down. A profit in the long run.
cues.STORY_D07_RESULT_WIN_004: Gob feel stronger too. Or just look stronger because room bigger?
cues.STORY_D07_RESULT_WIN_005: No. Your punches sound heavier than before.
cues.STORY_D07_RESULT_WIN_006: Pudding feels bouncier too. Do we get upgraded like rooms?
cues.STORY_D07_RESULT_WIN_007: So the facilities aren't the only things growing. You are too.
cues.STORY_D07_RESULT_WIN_008: Tomorrow, we will examine Pudding, Gob, and Pynn's progress. Rolo's scouting report should arrive as well.
cues.STORY_D08_MANAGEMENT_001: My lord, Pudding's body got tougher. Pudding bumped into a wall yesterday, and the wall said sorry first.
cues.STORY_D08_MANAGEMENT_003: No. It just cracked all over, so it looked sorry.
cues.STORY_D08_MANAGEMENT_004: The repair bill we just settled is walking right back in.
cues.STORY_D08_MANAGEMENT_005: Gob faster too! After breakfast, caught bowl before it hit floor!
cues.STORY_D08_MANAGEMENT_006: You're the one who dropped it.
cues.STORY_D08_MANAGEMENT_007: Made problem. Solved problem. Gob do work of two people!
cues.STORY_D08_MANAGEMENT_008: It may sound like a joke, but these are real signs of growth. All three are preparing for their next roles.
cues.STORY_D08_PRECOMBAT_001: My fireballs got bigger too. Tested one yesterday. Put out three candles at once.
cues.STORY_D08_PRECOMBAT_002: You fired fire, and the candles went out?
cues.STORY_D08_PRECOMBAT_003: Bit of a blast wave. Those scorch marks on the ceiling were already there.
cues.STORY_D08_PRECOMBAT_004: Scouting report! Four explorers spotted, with one thief trailing behind.
cues.STORY_D08_PRECOMBAT_005: Will you join the defense today, Rolo?
cues.STORY_D08_PRECOMBAT_006: For now, I'm more useful running with a map. If it catches fire in battle, we'll all get lost.
cues.STORY_D08_PRECOMBAT_007: Why are you looking at me?
cues.STORY_D08_PRECOMBAT_008: Understood. Rolo, take the outside roads. We'll guard the castle.
cues.STORY_D08_COMBAT_01_001: Today, we test your growth. Don't let the lone thief near the end slip past.
cues.STORY_D08_COMBAT_01_002: Pudding will hold longer than yesterday!
cues.STORY_D08_COMBAT_01_004: Then I'll roast them hotter than yesterday.
cues.STORY_D08_COMBAT_02_001: We're testing your growth, not holding a castle-burning contest!
cues.STORY_D08_COMBAT_02_002: Thief entering from the rear! Currently tying a shoelace at the corridor corner!
cues.STORY_D08_COMBAT_02_004: Careless, not nice. Catch them now.
cues.STORY_D08_RESULT_WIN_001: Pudding really lasted longer! Someday, could Pudding block the whole entrance alone?
cues.STORY_D08_RESULT_WIN_002: You don't have to do it alone. But if that's what you want, you'll become our strongest shield.
cues.STORY_D08_RESULT_WIN_003: Gob become Gob who catches every running enemy!
cues.STORY_D08_RESULT_WIN_004: And I'll be the Pynn who finishes off everyone you two catch, all at once.
cues.STORY_D08_RESULT_WIN_005: I'll spread that story through the village. With three times the excitement.
cues.STORY_D08_RESULT_WIN_006: Three times would be false advertising.
cues.STORY_D08_RESULT_WIN_007: Let's settle on two and a half.
cues.STORY_D08_RESULT_WIN_008: Exaggeration may be unnecessary. The kingdom is sending Iris, an official investigator.
cues.STORY_D09_MANAGEMENT_001: Today's visitor is no mere explorer. The kingdom's investigator, Iris, is coming in person.
cues.STORY_D09_MANAGEMENT_002: An investigator? Is this about taxes?
cues.STORY_D09_MANAGEMENT_003: In that case, I'll be the first to flee.
cues.STORY_D09_MANAGEMENT_004: Iris will record the routes from the entrance to the Barracks, Treasury, and even the throne.
cues.STORY_D09_MANAGEMENT_005: Can't we just steal the map?
cues.STORY_D09_MANAGEMENT_006: With that sort of person, the records in their head are more accurate than the map.
cues.STORY_D09_MANAGEMENT_007: Then hit head, knock records out?
cues.STORY_D09_MANAGEMENT_008: Your approach to problem-solving is as direct as ever.
cues.STORY_D09_MANAGEMENT_009: My analysis isn't finished, yet the defense line moved sooner than expected.
cues.STORY_D09_MANAGEMENT_010: Remember: the observer is also being observed.
cues.STORY_D09_PRECOMBAT_001: Entrance width, corridor length, guard rotations. This layout is more deliberate than expected.
cues.STORY_D09_PRECOMBAT_002: Naturally. Every stone was placed according to my brilliant design.
cues.STORY_D09_PRECOMBAT_003: Half was already a cave. The other half consists of construction errors.
cues.STORY_D09_PRECOMBAT_004: 'Demon Lord frequently confuses fact with theatrical effect.'
cues.STORY_D09_PRECOMBAT_006: Investigator, I've visited that room three times. I come out somewhere different every time.
cues.STORY_D09_PRECOMBAT_007: The route hasn't changed. You've taken the wrong one each time.
cues.STORY_D09_PRECOMBAT_008: Oh. Then I'll have to rewrite all three reports.
cues.STORY_D09_COMBAT_01_001: Pudding anchors the front, while Pynn adds firepower from the rear. Gob fills the gaps.
cues.STORY_D09_COMBAT_01_002: Don't pass arbitrary judgment on my minions in the middle of battle.
cues.STORY_D09_COMBAT_01_003: It isn't arbitrary. It's observation. The three work together better than expected.
cues.STORY_D09_COMBAT_02_001: Don't get excited over enemy praise. Still, the record's accurate.
cues.STORY_D09_COMBAT_02_002: Write about Gob too! 'Super strong and even super stronger!'
cues.STORY_D09_COMBAT_02_004: Two thieves are moving behind the investigator. Don't lose the vault while worrying about the report.
cues.STORY_D09_RESULT_WIN_001: This castle hasn't survived by chance. I'll raise its threat rating in my report.
cues.STORY_D09_RESULT_WIN_002: At last, an official royal document recognizes my majesty.
cues.STORY_D09_RESULT_WIN_003: A higher threat rating is not a congratulatory card. It means more troops.
cues.STORY_D09_RESULT_WIN_004: Majesty always comes with a bill.
cues.STORY_D09_RESULT_WIN_005: I'll change my old report title from 'Suspicious Hole' to 'Highly Suspicious Castle.'
cues.STORY_D09_RESULT_WIN_006: You finally called it a castle. Today's greatest achievement.
cues.STORY_D09_RESULT_WIN_007: By tomorrow, this place will be on the guild noticeboard. After that, expect hunting parties, not accidental visitors.
cues.STORY_D09_RESULT_WIN_008: And at the back of that party, we will likely find Leon, having studied the map again.
cues.STORY_D10_MANAGEMENT_001: Big news! Bad news! Or possibly good news! Our castle's name is on the guild noticeboard!
cues.STORY_D10_MANAGEMENT_002: At last! Did they spell it correctly?
cues.STORY_D10_MANAGEMENT_003: One letter was wrong, so I fixed it in secret. The handwriting looks a little different.
cues.STORY_D10_MANAGEMENT_004: The bounty is still small. The name takes up more space than the reward.
cues.STORY_D10_MANAGEMENT_005: Should I shorten the name or increase the bounty?
cues.STORY_D10_MANAGEMENT_006: No time to ponder that. A team is coming to verify Iris's report.
cues.STORY_D10_MANAGEMENT_007: My report was accurate. Today, I'll make a final assessment of your actual defenses.
cues.STORY_D10_MANAGEMENT_008: And this time, I've read the map! I won't get lost right at the entrance again!
cues.STORY_D10_PRECOMBAT_001: Leon, did you bring a new manual?
cues.STORY_D10_PRECOMBAT_002: Of course. I even bookmarked 'How to Conquer a Small Demon Castle.'
cues.STORY_D10_PRECOMBAT_004: I wanted to write 'Huge Demon Castle,' but that left far too much blank paper.
cues.STORY_D10_PRECOMBAT_005: That hero's taunts are improving faster than his skills.
cues.STORY_D10_PRECOMBAT_006: Leon's back! We just stop him getting through again, right?
cues.STORY_D10_PRECOMBAT_007: Gob remember Leon! Person who takes lots of hitting to fall down!
cues.STORY_D10_PRECOMBAT_008: Three explorers, one investigator, one thief, and Leon at the end. Today calls for everything we've learned about deployment.
cues.STORY_D10_COMBAT_01_001: Front line holding, confirmed. Response at the Treasury is faster too.
cues.STORY_D10_COMBAT_01_002: Stop taking notes and retreat. Today's report already has a conclusion: 'Invasion failed!'
cues.STORY_D10_COMBAT_01_003: Don't think the same route and traps will catch me again! I've studied them all!
cues.STORY_D10_COMBAT_01_004: Then here's your test. First question: what's the fastest way to avoid a fireball?
cues.STORY_D10_COMBAT_02_001: Raise my shield and move left... or was it right?
cues.STORY_D10_COMBAT_02_002: The correct answer is not entering someone else's castle in the first place.
cues.STORY_D10_COMBAT_02_003: Mock me all you like! This time, I'm reaching the Demon Lord's throne!
cues.STORY_D10_COMBAT_02_004: Come, Leon. We've grown while you've studied. Let's find out who learned more!
cues.STORY_D10_RESULT_WIN_001: Lost again. I memorized the map, but your movements weren't on it.
cues.STORY_D10_RESULT_WIN_002: A castle isn't just its rooms. It's the ones moving inside who make it a castle.
cues.STORY_D10_RESULT_WIN_005: I'll amend the guild report. This is a growing demon castle, not a temporary den.
cues.STORY_D10_RESULT_WIN_006: We've cleared our first major hurdle. The kingdom can no longer dismiss us as an accident.
cues.STORY_D10_RESULT_WIN_007: Instead, phrases like 'official warning,' 'investigation fees,' and 'registration review' are charging toward my ledger.
cues.STORY_D10_RESULT_WIN_008: I just saw a messenger! A warning bearing the royal seal arrives tomorrow morning!
cues.STORY_D01_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_001: Deep in the mountains stood a cave: a dot on the map that even delivery drivers couldn't find.
cues.STORY_D01_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_002: Ahem. From this day forth, this is my demon lord's castle. Soon the kingdom shall tremble!
cues.STORY_D01_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_003: The drops on the ceiling appear to be trembling first.
cues.STORY_D01_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_004: That's atmosphere. The entire cave is so terrified it's breaking into a cold sweat.
cues.STORY_D01_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_005: Maintaining that atmosphere requires two buckets. Our budget allows for one.
cues.STORY_D01_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_006: I become a demon lord, and my first meeting is about leaks?
cues.STORY_D01_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_007: A wet throne breeds mold. Once the mold sets in, your authority gets slippery.
cues.STORY_D01_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_008: Fine. I'll protect the throne, protect my minions, and try to keep a grip on my authority.
cues.STORY_D01_PLACEMENT_FRONT_001: Next to Pudding! Gob be the not-squishy fist beside the squishy wall!
cues.STORY_D01_PLACEMENT_FRONT_002: Two of us means twice as much no getting through!
cues.STORY_D01_PLACEMENT_REAR_001: Next to Pynn! Gob hit anyone who dodges the fire!
cues.STORY_D01_PLACEMENT_REAR_002: Good. I grill, you flip. Perfect kitchen teamwork.
cues.STORY_D01_PRECOMBAT_001: Pudding belongs at the front. That's the best place to block the path with that body.
cues.STORY_D01_PRECOMBAT_002: Pudding's good at blocking! Paths, drafts... conversations too, if it's urgent!
cues.STORY_D01_PRECOMBAT_003: Pynn fires from the rear. Put Pynn in front, and our backs are in more danger than the enemy.
cues.STORY_D01_PRECOMBAT_004: Safe distance secured. Now I just make their side unsafe, right?
cues.STORY_D01_PRECOMBAT_005: Where does Gob go? Block in front? Hit from behind? Can't Gob do both?
cues.STORY_D01_PRECOMBAT_006: I'll decide where Gob goes: beside Pudding to block the path, or beside Pynn for more firepower.
cues.STORY_D01_PRECOMBAT_007: The directive for everyone is Hold Position. Today, learn to stay where you're posted.
cues.STORY_D01_PRECOMBAT_008: Got it. Gob hold position. But if position runs away, can Gob chase it?
cues.STORY_D01_COMBAT_TIME_01_001: Is this the suspicious hole I've heard about? Hello! Are you scheduled to collapse today?
cues.STORY_D01_COMBAT_TIME_01_002: It's not a hole! It's a demon lord's castle awaiting its exterior walls!
cues.STORY_D01_COMBAT_TIME_02_001: The intruder is Milo, an explorer. Plenty of curiosity. Rather less common sense.
cues.STORY_D01_COMBAT_TIME_02_002: Oh, a squishy wall in front and fire from the back. What an unusual welcome party.
cues.STORY_D01_COMBAT_TIME_03_001: Pudding's not a wall! Pudding's cuter and bouncier!
cues.STORY_D01_COMBAT_TIME_03_002: It is a welcome party. Your gift is a fireball. No exchanges or refunds.
cues.STORY_D01_COMBAT_TIME_04_001: One moment! I'm changing my report from 'Uneventful Cave' to 'Far Too Eventful Cave'!
cues.STORY_D01_COMBAT_TIME_04_002: Change that last word too. It's a castle, not a cave. Give it three stars!
cues.STORY_D01_RESULT_WIN_001: Victory! A win on my very first day. I really was born to be a demon lord!
cues.STORY_D01_RESULT_WIN_002: Strictly speaking, three minions fought while you cheered very loudly beside the throne.
cues.STORY_D01_RESULT_WIN_003: A commander's voice is a weapon. My throat is now a battle casualty.
cues.STORY_D01_RESULT_WIN_004: Accounts settled. Notoriety and gold are up a little. The cough-drop budget is down a little.
cues.STORY_D01_RESULT_WIN_005: We saved our home! That means it's really our home now, right?
cues.STORY_D01_RESULT_WIN_006: Yes. Small and damp it may be, but if we defended it, it's our castle.
cues.STORY_D01_RESULT_WIN_007: Someone coming tomorrow too? Can Gob hit even more right now than today?
cues.STORY_D01_RESULT_WIN_008: Word of the Treasury opening has leaked. Tomorrow's guest will care more about the safe than the front door.
cues.STORY_D01_RESULT_LOSS_001: The throne is broken. Our claim to the property is already shaky on day one.
cues.STORY_D01_RESULT_LOSS_002: I haven't even finished paying it off!
cues.STORY_D02_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_001: The Treasury is open. Its main selling point is that the nameplate looks more expensive than the contents.
cues.STORY_D02_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_002: A Treasury! At last, a room worthy of a demon lord's castle.
cues.STORY_D02_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_003: The current treasure consists of a few gold coins, a bundle of receipts, and your overdue maintenance bill.
cues.STORY_D02_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_004: That last one isn't treasure. It's a classified document no one must ever find.
cues.STORY_D02_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_005: Which is why I placed it at the back of the safe. Someone absolutely must find it eventually.
cues.STORY_D02_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_006: Hi, rookie demon lord. Congrats on opening! I came to handle your first burglary.
cues.STORY_D02_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_007: I'll accept the congratulations. You may even cut the ribbon. Just don't cut into the safe.
cues.STORY_D02_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_008: Six out of ten for the welcome speech. One bonus point for that cute panicked face.
cues.STORY_D02_PRECOMBAT_001: Nia will target the Treasury before the throne. Guard only the main route, and she may slip through.
cues.STORY_D02_PRECOMBAT_002: That safe holds every coin this castle owns.
cues.STORY_D02_PRECOMBAT_003: Every coin, and a considerable portion of my reason for existing.
cues.STORY_D02_PRECOMBAT_004: Gob catch the fast one! Gob fast too! Fists move before thoughts!
cues.STORY_D02_PRECOMBAT_005: Doesn't that just mean your thoughts are slow?
cues.STORY_D02_PRECOMBAT_006: Really? If Gob hit thoughts, do they get faster?
cues.STORY_D02_PRECOMBAT_007: Pudding will block the path. Don't hit your thoughts. That sounds painful.
cues.STORY_D02_PRECOMBAT_008: Good. Lure her into the Spike Corridor. We'll explain our security policy to the soles of her feet!
cues.STORY_D02_COMBAT_TIME_01_001: The Treasury's my target. Thrones are heavy. Treasure is light.
cues.STORY_D02_COMBAT_TIME_01_002: The throne is valuable too! That wasn't an invitation!
cues.STORY_D02_COMBAT_TIME_02_001: My lord, please stop explaining our asset inventory to the enemy.
cues.STORY_D02_COMBAT_TIME_02_002: Thanks for the tip. I'll include the throne in my next estimate.
cues.STORY_D02_COMBAT_TIME_03_001: Stop! Gob hasn't hit you yet!
cues.STORY_D02_COMBAT_TIME_03_002: If a thief stops when you ask, that's a customer waiting in line.
cues.STORY_D02_COMBAT_TIME_04_001: Then I'll draw a line with fire. Take your hits in order, starting there.
cues.STORY_D02_COMBAT_TIME_04_002: Ow. Updating the security score. Cute and sloppy, but it stings more than expected.
cues.STORY_D02_RESULT_WIN_001: Treasure lost: zero. My heart nearly stopped from the shock.
cues.STORY_D02_RESULT_WIN_002: Treasure has been lost! The ledger entries are trembling. I have no hands, yet the handwriting trembles first!
cues.STORY_D02_RESULT_WIN_004: Precisely. It safely completed zero beats.
cues.STORY_D02_RESULT_WIN_005: Seven points for today's security. Pretty good for a beginner.
cues.STORY_D02_RESULT_WIN_006: Eight points today. Your score went up with the coins I carried out.
cues.STORY_D02_RESULT_WIN_007: Drop 'beginner.' Try 'demon lord with terrifying growth potential.'
cues.STORY_D02_RESULT_WIN_008: I could crack a safe in the time it takes to memorize that. I'll come play properly next time.
cues.STORY_D02_RESULT_WIN_009: You're welcome to visit. Just leave the money alone. I'll even make tea.
cues.STORY_D02_RESULT_WIN_010: There's no time for tea. Leon, an apprentice hero, is coming tomorrow without an appointment.
cues.STORY_D03_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_001: Leon, the apprentice hero, is approaching. This will be the final defense of your introductory training.
cues.STORY_D03_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_002: A hero at last. Bati, is my entrance speech ready?
cues.STORY_D03_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_003: Three lines prepared. I've also allowed for two and a half to be interrupted by combat.
cues.STORY_D03_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_004: The Recovery Nest is open too. We chose 'nest' because 'medical bill' sounded terrifying.
cues.STORY_D03_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_005: I labeled my fireball: 'To Justice, with heat.'
cues.STORY_D03_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_006: Are heroes really strong? If Pudding melts, can Pudding set again?
cues.STORY_D03_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_007: Fall back if you're in danger. Before we think about winning, I want everyone coming home.
cues.STORY_D03_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_008: Got it. Gob stay alive and hit lots. Gob good at both!
cues.STORY_D03_PRECOMBAT_001: The Survival First directive sends endangered minions back toward the Recovery Nest.
cues.STORY_D03_PRECOMBAT_002: Retreat isn't cowardice. It's regrouping so you can boast for longer next time.
cues.STORY_D03_PRECOMBAT_003: I don't think two Recovery Nests could handle your ego.
cues.STORY_D03_PRECOMBAT_004: My ego regenerates naturally. It's in excellent health.
cues.STORY_D03_PRECOMBAT_005: Demon lord! In the name of justice, I have come to end your darkness!
cues.STORY_D03_PRECOMBAT_006: He has beaten you to the entrance speech.
cues.STORY_D03_PRECOMBAT_007: He prepared lines too? The Heroes' Guild has excellent benefits.
cues.STORY_D03_PRECOMBAT_008: If they offer a speechwriting allowance, employment with the enemy merits consideration.
cues.STORY_D03_COMBAT_BOSS_HP_75_001: Demon Lord {{player_name}}! I am Leon, apprentice hero! I shall liberate this den of darkness!
cues.STORY_D03_COMBAT_BOSS_HP_75_002: It's a castle, not a den. Small for now, but use the proper title!
cues.STORY_D03_COMBAT_BOSS_HP_75_003: The hero manual lists evil strongholds as dens, caves, fortresses, et cetera!
cues.STORY_D03_COMBAT_BOSS_HP_75_004: Don't lump us under 'et cetera'! We're moving up in the world!
cues.STORY_D03_COMBAT_BOSS_HP_50_001: From out here, it looks like both of you grew your titles first. Your skills are still catching up.
cues.STORY_D03_COMBAT_BOSS_HP_50_002: Courage conquers traps! Ow! The manual didn't say how much they hurt!
cues.STORY_D03_COMBAT_BOSS_HP_25_001: Leon, if an apprentice can be a hero, a newcomer can be a demon lord. I'm not backing down.
cues.STORY_D03_COMBAT_BOSS_HP_25_002: Good. At least you're more than talk. Then I'm seeing this through too!
cues.STORY_D03_RESULT_WIN_001: I lost. Next time, I'll add a whole entry about your castle to the manual.
cues.STORY_D03_RESULT_WIN_002: Title it 'Never Underestimate a Rookie Demon Lord.'
cues.STORY_D03_RESULT_WIN_003: No. I'm going with 'A Small but Exceptionally Noisy Castle.'
cues.STORY_D03_RESULT_WIN_004: We're all alive! Pudding's nice and bouncy again!
cues.STORY_D03_RESULT_WIN_005: Yes. Winning is good, but having you back is better.
cues.STORY_D03_RESULT_WIN_006: Day three: apprentice hero repelled. We now have one piece of evidence for calling this cave a castle.
cues.STORY_D03_RESULT_WIN_007: Notoriety has risen sharply. Enough to attract both the Heroes' Guild and the tax office.
cues.STORY_D03_RESULT_WIN_008: Word spreads slowly if we only defend. Starting tomorrow, it's our turn to venture outside.
cues.STORY_D03_RESULT_LOSS_001: I did it! Though I feel a bit bad. That throne broke more easily than I expected.
cues.STORY_D03_RESULT_LOSS_002: That throne supported both my authority and my lower back!
cues.STORY_D04_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_001: Word of Leon's defeat is spreading. But notoriety will grow slowly if we simply wait here.
cues.STORY_D04_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_002: So we go to them? At last, I get to use the word 'invasion.'
cues.STORY_D04_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_003: Our first target is a signpost outside the village.
cues.STORY_D04_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_004: Say that again. I'm sure you meant 'fortress on the kingdom's frontier.'
cues.STORY_D04_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_005: A signpost, yes. A fortress would add three zeroes to our current budget.
cues.STORY_D04_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_006: Rolo, kobold scout captain, reporting! I handle finding paths, losing people, and inflating rumors!
cues.STORY_D04_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_007: Is that last one an official skill?
cues.STORY_D04_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_008: I put it in my report, so it is as of today!
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_001: The goal is to turn it slightly, not destroy it. Make explorers take the wrong road toward our castle.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_002: My first expedition is a battle against a wooden plank.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_003: Don't underestimate it. It has two whole nails.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_004: You may take only one or two companions on this expedition. The others will guard the castle.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_005: One signpost, and we're already making staffing decisions.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_006: Good management begins with not sending everyone to do a small job.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_007: Very well! Today we turn a signpost. One day, we'll turn the kingdom's entire sense of direction upside down!
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_008: If Gob hit it, does it turn?
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_009: Breaking it means failure. Today, use your wrist instead of your fist.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_010: I'm good at pushing things around. Push too hard and it might come out, though.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_011: Just turn it. Relocating the signpost can wait for the next expedition.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_012: Warm the nails a little, and it'll turn without much effort.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_013: Burn the sign too, and we'll get a compensation claim instead of control of the roads.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_001: No villagers in sight. Turn it now, and no one will know.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_002: A little to the left. Too far, and we won't find our way home either.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_003: A little... a little... How many hits is a little?
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_004: Don't hit it! Grab it and turn, like a doorknob!
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_005: I only pushed a little, but I think the ground's moving too.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_006: Leave the ground! Our territory doesn't reach this far yet!
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_007: Just heated the nails. Rolo can turn it now.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_008: Why didn't you cool the bit I have to hold?
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_009: Success! The 'Village' arrow now points toward our castle!
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_010: More precisely, our castle is now impersonating a village.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_011: Excellent! Our castle's amenities now include zero residents and one throne!
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_012: I filed the report under 'Operation: Seize the Kingdom's Transport Network'!
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_013: Actual cost: 5 food. Reported achievement: the entire kingdom. Very efficient.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_014: One little signpost will carry our name far and wide.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_015: For now, it will carry a few lost explorers in our direction.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_016: Being lost sounds scary. Can we give them directions before we hit them?
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_017: Any directions except the way to the throne. A friendly demon lord's castle has its charms.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_018: Stamping our seal on the forest supply crates could spread the rumors even further.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_019: We'll consider that for tomorrow's expedition. First, let's welcome our lost guests.
cues.STORY_D04_DEFENSE_ARRIVAL_001: I followed the sign. Why does the village start with a Spike Corridor?
cues.STORY_D04_DEFENSE_ARRIVAL_002: Our transport policy's first customer! We'll take your satisfaction survey after the battle!
cues.STORY_D05_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_001: The signpost is working. Lost explorers are arriving later and farther apart than usual.
cues.STORY_D05_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_002: Behold! Advanced tactics: turning the road itself into a weapon.
cues.STORY_D05_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_003: Actually, our corridor map is slightly wrong too. Our scouts got lost twice yesterday.
cues.STORY_D05_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_004: Don't tell the enemy. You'll ruin the mystique of advanced tactics.
cues.STORY_D05_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_005: Today, you may also choose an expedition to stamp our castle's seal on supply crates.
cues.STORY_D05_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_006: At last, we're interfering with the kingdom's supply network?
cues.STORY_D05_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_007: We won't steal the crates. Ink costs less than the expected proceeds from looting.
cues.STORY_D05_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_008: Our invasion keeps operating on a stationery-shop scale. Is that really okay?
cues.STORY_D05_PRECOMBAT_001: Excuse me! I'm sure I've passed this way before. Only the water stains look different!
cues.STORY_D05_PRECOMBAT_002: Our castle's passages form a labyrinth that reflects the intruder's mind.
cues.STORY_D05_PRECOMBAT_003: The builders connected the corridors incorrectly.
cues.STORY_D05_PRECOMBAT_004: Don't tell the enemy that either.
cues.STORY_D05_PRECOMBAT_005: Should Pudding show the lost people the exit?
cues.STORY_D05_PRECOMBAT_006: Gob show them an entrance! Where Gob's fist comes in!
cues.STORY_D05_PRECOMBAT_007: That's a declaration of war, not directions.
cues.STORY_D05_PRECOMBAT_008: Hold them off without getting hurt, and keep them from the throne. Today is our maze's first customer review!
cues.STORY_D05_COMBAT_TIME_01_001: This room again! Even the squishy wall is exactly where it was!
cues.STORY_D05_COMBAT_TIME_01_002: You remember Pudding? Still not getting through!
cues.STORY_D05_COMBAT_TIME_02_001: I remember, but I wouldn't call this a happy reunion!
cues.STORY_D05_COMBAT_TIME_02_002: Lost? Follow Gob! Gob doesn't know where Gob's going either!
cues.STORY_D05_COMBAT_TIME_03_001: Don't follow Gob! That especially goes for our side!
cues.STORY_D05_COMBAT_TIME_03_002: Exit's at the end of that corridor. Just a few fireballs along the way.
cues.STORY_D05_COMBAT_TIME_04_001: That's not an exit. That's a cooking process!
cues.STORY_D05_COMBAT_TIME_04_002: Now do you understand? Every path in this castle has a story!
cues.STORY_D05_RESULT_WIN_001: I'll admit it. This place is small, but somehow long enough that I never want to come back.
cues.STORY_D05_RESULT_WIN_002: 'Small, yet long.' The finest architectural review I've received today.
cues.STORY_D05_RESULT_WIN_004: The village is already talking! 'Don't trust the signs' and 'Watch out for the demon lord's castle' at the same time!
cues.STORY_D05_RESULT_WIN_005: Two rumors from one signpost. An excellent return on investment.
cues.STORY_D05_RESULT_WIN_006: Nobody reached the throne today either. Our home's paths did a good job!
cues.STORY_D05_RESULT_WIN_007: Yes. Twisted as they are, to our friends, they're still the way home.
cues.STORY_D05_RESULT_WIN_008: A note from Nia. She says she'll reassess Treasury security tomorrow.
cues.STORY_D05_RAID_RESULT_001: Every supply crate has our seal! One's upside down, but it looked more suspicious, so I left it!
cues.STORY_D05_RAID_RESULT_002: The kingdom will likely mistake this for an organized attack on its supply network.
cues.STORY_D05_RAID_RESULT_003: One stamp, and suddenly we're an organization. The kingdom thinks more highly of us than we do.
